evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Maintain the declared pinned Goose runtime and native GitHub MCP/session smoke conjunction.
intent.acceptance: The protected host requires checksum-verified source-declared Goose, a completed structured run, correlated successful native GitHub MCP requests/responses, canonical matched session events, independently merged PR identities and the remaining declared smoke fixtures.

predicates: The complete source-defined Goose host conjunction establishes native runtime/MCP/session capability.
evidence.opportunity: Initial execution attempts with immutable source-bound native host assertions; reruns do not create duplicate proof.
filters: Only the exact reviewed protected job, its source-defined assertion steps and transitive local checker dependencies establish proof.
An overall successful run, job, agent reply, issue or unverified artifact does not establish the native predicate.
A failed assertion may reflect missing evidence, infrastructure or unmet preconditions; never infer a failed constituent behavior.
Known native proofs remain visible through incomplete historical coverage; complete totals require every eligible assessment.

Native assertions are one conjunction, not independently counted feature deliveries. Fixture booleans and file existence alone do not establish compilation correctness; full build behavior, telemetry and exclusive causation remain separate.
A historical pinned-runtime MCP proof does not certify the current Goose version or absence of every parser/session error. Historical parser validity beyond the protected assertions remains separate.
evidence.collection: Replay bounded, digest-checked Actions step receipts, immutable source/dependency identities and verified initial-attempt checkouts.

model.architecture: Exact native predicate verification on the protected runner, preserving unobserved assessments.
model.recommendation: Review native proof coverage separately from inferred causation, costs and keep/retire decisions.
